description:
Conquer Every Road with Puncture Resistance
Say goodbye to flat-tire anxiety. Equipped with 27.5" puncture-resistant tires and a lockable front suspension, this bike glides effortlessly over city potholes, gravel paths, and sandy trails. Experience a smooth, worry-free ride regardless of the terrain.
Seamless Smart Control & NFC Unlock
Experience the future of commuting. With the integrated HITWAY App and NFC unlocking, your smartphone becomes your key. Track your riding stats in real-time, adjust assist levels, and enjoy a high-tech, keyless lifestyle that fits your modern routine.
Precision Hybrid Performance
Master every hill with the perfect synergy of a 250W high-speed motor and a professional 21-speed transmission system. Whether you need a boost for steep inclines or want to cruise at a steady 25km/h, the three PAS levels provide tailored power for an effortless journey.
Stylish Power that Goes the Distance
The high-capacity 36V 460.9Wh battery is elegantly embedded into the frame for a sleek look and added protection. Enjoy an extended range of up to 80km on a single charge—more than enough for a full week of commuting or a long weekend adventure.
Fully Equipped & Ready to Go
No need for extra purchases. This e-bike is a complete urban solution, featuring a sturdy rear rack for your gear, protective fenders for rainy days, and bright front/rear lights for night safety. High-end utility meets incredible value in one sleek package.
